questions.prompt: At 300–500bb, the hands that can stack someone are mostly…

choices.text: Sets, straights, flushes, and the nutted two pair. One pair is not enough.

questions.explanation: Nut potential is the whole game when stacks are this deep.

questions.prompt: Position is worth more very deep because…

choices.text: More streets remain, so acting last avoids the big blunders.

questions.explanation: A mistake at 400bb costs a buy-in, not a few blinds.

choices.text: Do not put in 400bb without a hand that beats the hands willing to call.
Bet the pot with air because the stack is large

questions.explanation: The deeper you are, the stronger the hand you need to build the biggest pot.

choices.text: Before the flop: which hands can make the nuts, and which cannot.

questions.explanation: If the hand cannot make a very strong hand, it should not play a very large pot.
